company_fresh.data_notice: These figures are read from the company's own quarterly results filings on NSE. Each one links to its filing, with the filing's date and fingerprint.

basis.label: Consolidated: the company and its subsidiaries together

ttm_revenue.label: Sales over the last four quarters
ttm_revenue.formula: Revenue from operations, added up over the four most recent quarters

ttm_net_profit.label: Profit over the last four quarters
ttm_net_profit.formula: Profit for the company's owners, added up over the four most recent quarters

ttm_eps.label: Earnings per share over the last four quarters
ttm_eps.formula: Basic earnings per share, added up over the four most recent quarters

revenue_growth_quarter.label: Sales against the same quarter a year ago
revenue_growth_quarter.formula: (sales this quarter - sales in the same quarter a year earlier) / sales in the same quarter a year earlier
revenue_growth_quarter.period: Three months ended 2024-12-31 against Three months ended 2023-12-31

profit_growth_quarter.label: Profit against the same quarter a year ago
profit_growth_quarter.formula: (profit this quarter - profit in the same quarter a year earlier) / profit in the same quarter a year earlier
profit_growth_quarter.period: Three months ended 2024-12-31 against Three months ended 2023-12-31

revenue_growth_ttm.label: Sales over four quarters against the four quarters a year before
revenue_growth_ttm.formula: (sales over the last four quarters - sales over the same four quarters a year earlier) / the latter
revenue_growth_ttm.period: Four quarters ended 31 Dec 2024 against the four quarters ended 31 Dec 2023

profit_growth_ttm.label: Profit over four quarters against the four quarters a year before
profit_growth_ttm.formula: (profit over the last four quarters - profit over the same four quarters a year earlier) / the latter
profit_growth_ttm.period: Four quarters ended 31 Dec 2024 against the four quarters ended 31 Dec 2023

revenue_change_3y.label: Sales over four quarters against the same four quarters three years ago
revenue_change_3y.reason: This needs four quarters in a row and only 0 are held.
revenue_change_3y.formula: (sales over the last four quarters - sales over the same four quarters three years earlier) / the latter

profit_change_3y.label: Profit over four quarters against the same four quarters three years ago
profit_change_3y.reason: This needs four quarters in a row and only 0 are held.
profit_change_3y.formula: (profit over the last four quarters - profit over the same four quarters three years earlier) / the latter

net_margin.label: Profit as a share of sales
net_margin.formula: profit over the last four quarters / sales over the last four quarters

operating_margin.label: Operating profit as a share of sales
operating_margin.formula: (sales - expenses other than finance costs) / sales, over the last four quarters

profitable_quarters.label: Quarters with a profit in the last eight
profitable_quarters.formula: the number of the last eight quarters in which profit for the owners was above zero
profitable_quarters.period: The last eight quarters, ended 31 Dec 2024

interest_cover.label: How many times profit covers the interest bill
interest_cover.formula: (profit before tax + finance costs) / finance costs, over the last four quarters

pe.label: Price compared with earnings (P/E)
pe.formula: the platform's last close / earnings per share over the last four quarters
pe.period: Close of 28 Feb 2025 against earnings for the four quarters ended 31 Dec 2024

earnings_yield.label: Earnings as a share of the price
earnings_yield.formula: earnings per share over the last four quarters / the platform's last close
earnings_yield.period: Close of 28 Feb 2025 against earnings for the four quarters ended 31 Dec 2024

debt_to_equity.label: Borrowings compared with the owners' money
debt_to_equity.formula: (current borrowings + non-current borrowings) / equity of the owners, at the balance-sheet date
debt_to_equity.note: Lease liabilities are not itemised in the results filing, so they are not counted.

roe.label: Profit as a share of the owners' money
roe.formula: profit over the last four quarters / equity of the owners at the latest balance-sheet date
roe.period: Four quarters ended 31 Dec 2024 against equity at 30 Sep 2024
roe.note: Approximate: profit is for the last four quarters but equity is at one date, and the year's average equity is not used.

pb.label: Price compared with the owners' money per share (P/B)
pb.formula: the platform's last close / (equity of the owners / shares in issue), at the latest balance-sheet date
pb.period: Close of 28 Feb 2025 against equity at 30 Sep 2024
pb.note: Uses the number of shares filed with the balance sheet.
